import hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd().resolve()
work = root.parent
evidence = work / "checks/5f9a2df57599"
folder = evidence / "native-export-release"
example_report_path = evidence / "native-export-release-report.json"
helper_path = work / "check_public_exports.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("_wall_public_check", helper_path)
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
reports = {}
for name, subdir, queries in (("actor", "turns", 1), ("controller", "private/controllers", 4)):
    report = helper.inspect([folder / subdir], queries=queries, demos=3)
    with (evidence / f"native-{name}-conformance-release.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        json.dump(report, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        handle.write("\n")
    reports[name] = report

sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
raw = lambda value: (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
example = json.loads(example_report_path.read_bytes())
manifest = json.loads((folder / "manifest.json").read_bytes())
context = json.loads((folder / "private/context.json").read_bytes())
metadata = [json.loads(line) for line in (folder / "private/metadata.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
findings = []
def require(condition, detail):
    if not condition:
        findings.append(detail)

require(all(report["status"] == "passed" for report in reports.values()), "consumer conformance failed")
require(manifest["complete"] is True and manifest["training_admitted"] is False, "completion or admission marker differs")
require(example["native_acceptance"] == "owner_pending" and example["training_admitted"] is False, "example status claims acceptance")
require(example["manifest_sha256"] == sha(folder / "manifest.json"), "example manifest binding differs")
actual_files = {p.relative_to(folder).as_posix() for p in folder.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
require(actual_files == set(manifest["files"]) | {"manifest.json"}, "file inventory differs")
require(all(sha(folder / name) == digest for name, digest in manifest["files"].items()), "saved file hash differs")
require(context["source_sha256"] == example["source_sha256"], "private source bindings differ")
require(all(sha(root / name) == digest for name, digest in example["source_sha256"].items()), "current source differs from export")
native = context["native_execution"]
require(native["racket"] == example["racket"] and native["racket"]["backend"] == "racket" and native["racket"]["protected"] is True, "protected execution identity differs")
require(hashlib.sha256(raw(native)).hexdigest() == example["native_execution_sha256"], "native execution object hash differs")
require(native["racket_evaluations"] == example["racket_evaluations"] == 20, "native evaluation count differs")
require(len(metadata) == len(native["episodes"]) == 2, "episode count differs")
require({row["episode"]["native_wrapper"]["settings"]["side_boundary_policy"] for row in metadata} == {"canvas_edges", "gray_walls"}, "settings differ")
serialize = helper.serializer()
ordered_turns = []
for row in metadata:
    episode = row["episode"]
    wrapper = episode["native_wrapper"]
    require(wrapper in native["episodes"], "native wrapper was not preserved")
    require(episode["train"] == wrapper["train"] and episode["test"] == wrapper["test"], "retained labels differ from native wrapper")
    require(episode["program_solution"] == wrapper["program"], "retained program differs from native wrapper")
    require(hashlib.sha256(wrapper["program"].encode()).hexdigest() == wrapper["program_sha256"], "retained program hash differs")
    require(wrapper["seed"] == 0 and len(wrapper["train"]) == 3 and len(wrapper["test"]) == 4, "seed or pair counts differ")
    controller = folder / "private/controllers" / (row["controller_id"] + ".json")
    require(controller.read_bytes() == serialize(wrapper), "controller bytes differ from native wrapper")
    require(len(row["turn_ids"]) == 4, "ordered turn mapping length differs")
    for identifier, pair in zip(row["turn_ids"], wrapper["test"], strict=True):
        turn = folder / "turns" / (identifier + ".json")
        require(turn.read_bytes() == serialize({"train": wrapper["train"], "test": [pair]}), "one-query bytes differ")
    first = folder / "turns" / (row["turn_ids"][0] + ".json")
    require(first.read_bytes() == serialize({"train": episode["train"], "test": episode["test"][:1]}), "single/four query first-turn bytes differ")
    ordered_turns.extend(row["turn_ids"])
require(sorted(ordered_turns) == example["turn_ids"], "reported turn IDs differ from ordered private mappings")
inspection = {
    "schema": "arcpuzzles-native-wall-export-inspection-v1",
    "status": "failed" if findings else "passed",
    "findings": findings,
    "controller_files": reports["controller"]["files_checked"],
    "actor_files": reports["actor"]["files_checked"],
    "private_episode_rows": len(metadata),
    "manifest_sha256": sha(folder / "manifest.json"),
    "example_report_sha256": sha(example_report_path),
    "source_bindings_checked": len(example["source_sha256"]),
    "consumer_helper_sha256": sha(helper_path),
    "public_serializer_sha256": sha(root / "shared/runtime/reviewer_support.py"),
    "racket_evaluations_retained": native["racket_evaluations"],
    "reference_labels_reexecuted_by_inspection": False,
    "training_admitted": False,
    "limits": "Read-only saved-file/identity/source checks using the packet consumer helper; native label execution is retained from make_examples, not repeated."
}
with (evidence / "native-export-inspection-release.json").open("x", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(inspection, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"status": inspection["status"], "controller_files": inspection["controller_files"], "actor_files": inspection["actor_files"], "findings": findings}, sort_keys=True))
raise SystemExit(bool(findings))
